audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read "Skill" while the content layer and packet levelChart read Karma / Karma / Karma / Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora. The page also called this EVEN at 5.5/10 against a 40% win rate over 45 games.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is 900 against Karma's 950 and costs 60 a cast, and Across the Veil does not exist at level 1 — so the first three levels are Karma's, narrowly. From 6 the lane belongs to Aurora: Between Worlds (140/120/100s) adds a shockwave, a slow zone and a teleport across it, and Spirit Abjuration heals her back through exactly the chip Karma's pattern is built on. A 40% win rate is not even.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides realigned to the content layer with every why rewritten to match. diff moved EVEN to TRICKY, diffRating 5.5/10 to 7/10, carry threat 6/10 to 7/10, and both copies of the rating sentence updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 and First-item full-layer whys still described Karma pressing an early lead on rows whose verdict is Aurora, and content whys[5] said "Level 6 remains hers" under the First-item label.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1 and 100s at rank 3, cast at 250 range; the first-item stage is where Spirit Abjuration's healing plus damage makes even trades profitable for her rather than for Karma.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten with the real cooldown and the correct owner; whys[5] moved onto its own label.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called Aurora's kit "melee-adjacent", and Spirit Abjuration's healing never appeared anywhere on the page despite being the mechanic that decides every extended trade.
audit.why: Aurora's Q is 900 range, her E is 825 and her W hop is 700 — nothing about the kit is melee-adjacent, and the poke war is decided by 950 versus 900, not by her having to walk in. Riot's text on Spirit Abjuration: spirits exorcised from enemies she damages follow her and heal her, so chip damage is refunded unless Grievous Wounds is already on her.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten around the real 950-vs-900 gap and Grievous Wounds timing; the healing is now also stated in enemyWin, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: no cooldown-sequencing advice existed anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 falling to 18s, The Weirding 15s to 11s, Between Worlds 140/120/100s. Karma's own E is 10s to 8s. Those four numbers are what make "wait for X before you Y" concrete.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with all three of her cooldowns; Karma's E cooldown added to dontsFull[1].d; the Q recast tell added to dontsFull[0].d.

notes:
CHART: all seven full-layer sides read "Skill" while the content layer and packet levelChart agreed on Karma / Karma / Karma / Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora. Full layer moved onto that verdict, whys rewritten alongside. Six rows therefore carry a full-layer side edit with no paired win[N] edit, because win[] was already correct.

DIFFICULTY: EVEN at 5.5/10 against a 40% win rate over 45 games. Moved to TRICKY / 7-of-10 with the tone colour and both rating sentences, matching what I did on anivia for the same reason.

CONTENT whys[] INDEX DRIFT — FIFTH OCCURRENCE. whys[5] read "Level 6 remains hers" under the First-item label. Five of my seven matchups carry this same one-slot shift; the two that do not (ahri, aurelionsol) are the ones whose whys were written differently in the first place. This is a defect in champ-data/content/mid/karma.js as a whole and should be swept across every karma matchup, not fixed matchup-by-matchup by seven separate agents.

ANTI-HEAL: Spirit Abjuration is the reason the chip-and-poke pattern underperforms here, and it appeared nowhere on the page. I stated the mechanic and the need for Grievous Wounds but gave no numbers — Riot's text does not quantify the healing, and I will not invent a magnitude.

Unverified, so not asserted: whether Karma's W reveal defeats the invisibility from Across the Veil specifically (the W is flagged revealsStealth and the hop grants invisibility, but invisibility and camouflage behave differently and the file does not settle which this is — I wrote only that W reveals her, not that it can be cast into the hop), and whether the W root can interrupt Between Worlds' leap.
